name: First-Heard
clergy: the First-Heard, a newly formed sect within the Censer who believe the song's return is not a threat but a second chance
attitude_to_magic: The Glimmer is the song made manifest; First-Heard believes it is not a curse but a call to a new age.

worship_by_species.name: First-Heard
worship_by_species.note: A minority faction among the Censer's order who believe the Year of Ashfall's Glimmer return is a second chance rather than a threat; they are suspected by the majority Censer hierarchy.

worship_by_species.name: the-Anvil-Ring
worship_by_species.note: The deep-folk hear the song as a physical vibration; the-Anvil-Ring is the vibration before the hammer falls.

worship_by_species.name: the-New-Leaf
worship_by_species.note: The greenfolk say the song's return is the forest's spring; the-New-Leaf is the first bud.

worship_by_species.name: the-Desert-Song
worship_by_species.note: In the Burning Sands, the song is the Desert-Song; it calls the oases, and those who hear it are changed.
